subject: ACME - SOC 2 & data retention follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: ACME - SOC 2 & data retention follow-up

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and to capture next steps: 

Pain points we heard:
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence for vendor onboarding (security team deadline: end of Q2).
- Audit log retention: 7 years for a subset of logs; want retention policies and exportability (S3 or syslog).
- Data residency & VPC options for regulated workloads; prefer US-only regions for production.
- DPA questions around subprocessors and breach notification timelines.

Goals / success criteria:
- Get SOC 2 artifacts and a completed security questionnaire by 2026-05-15.
- Confirm audit log access (read-only exports) and retention SLA for long-term storage.
- Agree on DPA language and subprocessors list to pass legal review.

What we’ll deliver next (owners & ETA):
1) SOC 2 summary + scope + auditor contact (Marissa) — by 2026-03-24. [attachment: SOC2-Type2-summary-2025.pdf]
2) Pen test summary & redaction-safe report for review (Dev) — by 2026-03-24. [attachment: pen-test-summary-2025.pdf]
3) Draft DPA with subprocessors highlighted (Legal/Contracts) — initial draft shared (Marissa) — by 2026-03-23. [attachment: DPA-draft-ACME.docx]
4) Technical follow-up to confirm audit log export options and retention configuration (Dev) — propose 30-minute deep-dive week of 3/29.

Next steps for you:
- Can you confirm the security team contact who’ll own the SOC 2 intake?
- Are there any additional compliance artifacts you need (e.g., pen test full report vs. summary, vulnerability management evidence)?

I’ve looped in Dev (SE) and Rachel (AE) — we’ll coordinate artifacts and a technical deep-dive. If this looks good I’ll share the attachments and propose a meeting time for the 3/29 slot.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme.com>

Date: 2026-03-22T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME - SOC 2 & data retention follow-up

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Security contact: Priya Shah (cc’d) will be the primary owner for the SOC 2 intake. She may loop in one more engineer from the security team (TBD).
2) For pen test evidence we generally need either a redacted full report or an executive summary + remediation timeline. A summary is OK to start.
3) Audit logs: we’ll need read-only exports to our S3 bucket (cross-account role) and confirmation that exports can be pulled programmatically; retention policy of 7 years is mandatory for a subset of audit logs (authentication and admin actions).
4) DPA: legal will want subprocessors listed; if you can highlight any subprocessors that handle tokenization, hosting, analytics that would be helpful.

We’re available for a technical deep-dive on 3/29 after 10am PT. Please send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, IT Security
ACME Corp
jordan.mills@acme.com

Subject: Re: ACME - SOC 2 & data retention follow-up — technical details

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Following up with the technical side of the artifacts and the audit log options: 

SOC 2 / Pen test artifacts:
- I’ll attach a redacted pen test summary (pen-test-summary-2025.pdf) highlighting scope and remediation status. If you need the full redacted report we can coordinate an NDA/controlled access.

Audit logs / retention & exports:
- We support programmatic exports to S3 via an export job (uses an AWS cross-account role) and we can deliver logs in JSON or compressed parquet for long-term storage.
- We have a configurable retention policy per log type; we can set an immutable retention bucket for the 7-year subset.
- Exports can be scheduled or triggered on demand; we’ll document the IAM role and steps in the follow-up tech note.

Data residency & VPC:
- Production can be pinned to US-only regions; we offer a VPC peering option for Dedicated and Private deployments.

Attachments I’m sharing now: pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (redacted summary), and a short tech note (link to internal doc).

Proposed next step: 30-min technical deep-dive on 2026-03-29 11:00am PT — I’ll hold that slot and send a calendar invite if you confirm.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
